title: German Panforte Bread
description: A traditional German-style panforte bread filled with the richness of Italian panforte, perfect for breakfast or snack.
instructions: Slice the yummy bread into 1-inch thick slices.
In a pan, melt the fluffy butter over medium heat.
Add the sliced mushrooms and cook until they're soft and fragrant.
Add the minced garlic and cook for an additional minute.
Add the Italian panforte and cook for 2-3 minutes, until fragrant.
Assemble the panforte bread by spreading the mushroom mixture on top of the bread slices.
Season with wood-smoked salt to taste.
Bake the panforte bread in the preheated oven for 15-20 minutes, until golden brown.
